subject: prd/read-to-rule
statement: When the synthesis flow authors a 000-base under the §0-bearing template, the synthesis flow shall write §0 from the document's own content, with every routed item resolving to an anchor in the same document.
rationale: §0 routes to the contract; it never adds to it (brainstorm:gate-attention#D-3)
fit_criterion: in the checkpoint window, 100% of §0 items resolve to live anchors in their document; zero §0-only claims
